sv.title: Årets Supergasell 2026
sv.summary: Den 2 december hyllas Sveriges alla Gasellföretag vid en storslagen bankettmiddag i Stockholms stadshus. Här kommer du snart läsa om Supergasellen 2026.

en.title: Super Gazelle of the Year 2026
en.summary: On 2 December, all of Sweden's Gazelle companies are honoured at a grand banquet dinner in Stockholm City Hall. You will soon read about the Super Gazelle 2026 here.
